$comment: Cover sheet for :widget-catalog, the `remote-widgets` system: Mobile Launcher Widgets in Remote Compose. The inventory lives in @CatalogComponent annotations under widget-catalog/src/main/kotlin/ee/schimke/remotewidgets/, as it does for :remote-catalog. A design system of its own rather than a mode of `remote-m3`: it draws with remote-creation-compose and remote-foundation only (no remote-material3, no Glance Wear), and its breakpoints are LAUNCHER GRID SIZES rather than devices — each `size` is a cell count, its dp the portrait size Android documents for it, (73n - 16) x (118m - 16), at the Pixel 4's 440dpi the table was measured on. WidgetSizeTest holds these to WidgetSizes.kt. No referenceKits and no compareWith: there is no published design kit for launcher widgets and no sibling sheet to pair with. Light mode, because a launcher widget sits on a wallpaper under the device's day theme by default and its stickers paint their own surface.
title: Remote Compose Launcher Widgets
